title: BnF Espagnol 318, the five ciphered letters of the Catholic Monarchs' correspondence, 1497-1504 (catalogue item 9)

steps.what: Mapped the five ciphered letters in the volume from the manifest and notice (catalogue listed four).
No. 5 found printed by Parisi 2020; no. 95 key found in Lasry/Tomokiyo.
No. 92 matched to the Cifra general (Galende Díaz 1994) against eight interlinear glosses, no misses; key transcribed (683 groups).
No. 92 specimen line decoded: 'y tiempo, por estar en tanto'.
No. 93 f. 118r segmented and clustered: sign alphabet plus CVC groups; code initials point to the Gran cifra.
No. 93 as plain homophonic letter stream, annealed against Spanish 5-grams.
No. 95 f. 122r segmented and Ward-clustered, clusters labelled from Lasry's key (64 % clean clusters).
No. 95 hybrid decode checked by eye: franceses, Francia, que puedan, muy grandes cosas; about two thirds of signs; two Lasry signs corrected.
Band-clipped segmentation and DP template tiling for no. 95; no gain beyond the same two thirds.
No. 95 re-examined: cryptiana GL.htm says Lasry solved the letter itself in 2022, not just its alphabet. The page and the ranking (novelty 5 to 3) were corrected.

No. 92 ff. 116r-116v transcribed line by line (36 + 11 lines) by eye from 1:1 line strips of the 4155-px scans, against Galende's p. 167 sign alphabet; A5 (⊃#), E5 (q over k), LL (crossed T) and the con- abbreviation identified as frequent signs.

No. 92 read in part (f116_reading.md): the Great Captain's terms for joining Venice against the Turk in 1500 — ports in Italy (Brindisi, Otranto in Apulia held by Venice) for sick, wounded and supplies; about three quarters of words; 11 codes contradict Galende's printed values in context (zie, zap, bog …).

No. 92 second pass online: Tomokiyo's commented-out partial reading (cryptiana spanish.htm) fixes zap=zag, bac=vac, xie=cargo; Sanuto Diarii III corroborates the port/victuals demand; RAH 9/15 not digitised; no printed clear copy found (CODOIN, Zurita, BRAH Noticias, archive.org).

No. 92 recto ll. 8-11 re-read with Sanuto's terms as cribs (cruciata, jubileo, precedence, paid victuals): none present; the re-read settled zie = parescer (zie+RIA 'pareceria tener'), vog = acatamiento, zer read as zec = mas, and ll. 8-11 now read in sense.

outcome.method_basis: No. 92 was read with the Cifra general printed by Galende Diaz (1994), which Tomokiyo had already assigned to this letter; the project proved it against eight interlinear glosses on f. 116r. No. 95 was read in stretches with Lasry's 2022 key published on cryptiana. No. 5 was already printed by Parisi (2020).
outcome.notes: No. 5 already solved; no. 92 both pages transcribed and about three quarters read (21 Sept 2026); no. 95 about two thirds; nos. 93-94 unread, blocked on BNE MSS 20.211/52. fraction_read 0.3 is an estimate by letter from the notes (no. 5 read in print, no. 95 about two thirds of f. 122r, no. 92 about three quarters, nos. 93-94 none), not a measurement. Raised to 0.4 on 21 Sept 2026 when no. 92 was read.

gaps.item: No. 92 (f. 116r-v), about a quarter of the words
gaps.detail: both pages transcribed and read in part (f116_reading.md); 5 code groups (bog, zeb, zems, xob, bue) contradict Galende's printed values in context; ~10 letter-sign stretches unplaced; needs BRAH 9/15 ff. 7-9 or a higher-magnification sign pass
CVC nomenclator with atomic groups (homophonic anneal on ct93_eye.txt failed, -3.5 vs -1.8 nats); the suspected Gran cifra key survives only as Bergenroth's partial list (BNE MSS 20.211/52)
never transcribed; Bergenroth's Gran-cifra list not tested against it (next steps 1-2 in the notes)

gaps.item: No. 95 f. 122r, about a third of the glyphs
gaps.detail: eye, cluster-hybrid and tiling readings agree on the same two thirds; touching signs at 4100 px full resolution; the line-by-line correction walk is still to do
segmented (f122v_reseg.pkl) but not decoded with the f. 122r templates

outcome.fraction_read_source: Not measurable: no. 5 is read only in Parisi's print (no token file here), no. 94 is untranscribed, and f116_reading.md / f122r_reading.md are prose readings without token-level unread marks. 0.4 kept: an estimate by letter (no. 5 read, no. 92 ~3/4, no. 95 f. 122r ~2/3, nos. 93-94 none).

prior.where: No. 5 printed by Parisi 2020; no. 95 solved by Lasry 2022 (GL.htm: 'is solved'; alphabet published as an image, no plaintext); no. 92 key printed by Galende Díaz 1994 and partial interlinear gloss; nos. 93-94 none

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
